faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Choose an evaluation size, complete registration, and begin trading on our platform. The evaluation starts immediately after payment confirmation.
faq.a2: The fee is one-time. It can be refunded only before your account is delivered and in the cases listed in the Refund and Cancellation Policy; after delivery it is non-refundable.
faq.q3: How long until I get funded?
faq.a3: After reaching the profit target and completing the minimum trading days, the funded account is delivered within 2 business days (Dubai time).
faq.q4: How do I withdraw my profits?
faq.a4: Rewards are paid by crypto-currency or by internal transfer to your account with Fiper, after at least 10 trading days on the funded account and a completed 14-day cycle.
faq.a5: Forex, indices, commodities and selected crypto-currencies on cTrader.
faq.a6: No formal experience required, but understanding risk management and the trading rules is essential for success.

faq.title: What traders ask before they start
faq.q1: How is the daily loss limit calculated?
faq.a1: {{daily}} of the equity at the start of the day, measured at 00:00 Dubai time and reset every day at that hour. Floating losses of open positions count, and what is left before the limit is shown on the home screen in dollars.
faq.q2: When can I request my first payout?
faq.a2: After {{days}} trading days on the funded account, then every {{cycle}} days. Your share is {{share}} of the cycle’s profit, {{range}} per request; review within two business days and execution within one.
faq.q3: What happens when a rule is breached?
faq.a3: The account is closed on the trade that crossed the limit and trading on it stops; you receive the breach report with the figures. The fee is not refunded after the account is delivered, and you can start a new evaluation.
faq.a4: The fee is paid once and is refunded only before your account is delivered, and in the cases listed in the Refund and Cancellation Policy. After delivery it is not refunded.
faq.q5: Which instruments can I trade, and with what leverage?
faq.a5: Forex, metals, indices, energy and selected crypto-currencies on cTrader. Leverage up to 1:{{forex}} for forex, 1:{{metals}} for metals, 1:{{indices}} for indices, 1:{{energy}} for energy and 1:{{crypto}} for crypto — swap-free.
faq.q6: How do I verify a certificate?
faq.a6: Every certificate carries a code in the form FPT-XXXXXXXXXX. Enter it in the verification field above or open the public verification page in the app: it shows the certificate’s status, the holder’s name, its kind and the account size, without signing in.
